name: Kuuru
source: Kuuru is a passive, nihilistic wallflower who doesn't like to get involved. What she lacks in social skills she makes up for in cup sizes. She tends to only chime in with dispassionate quips, but don't even get her started on adult avant-garde sock puppet theatre.
